parameters.name: AutoPay
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to automatically pay the bill for the subscription instance. Valid values: 

- **true**

- **false** (default)

parameters.name: Bandwidth
parameters.description: The peak bandwidth of the IPv6 Translation Service instance. Valid values: **1** to **200**. Unit: Mbit/s.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a parameter value from your client to ensure uniqueness across different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters.

parameters.name: Ipv6TranslatorId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the IPv6 transform service.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region of the IPv6 Translation Service instance. You can call the **DescribeRegions** operation to query region IDs.
